result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility and styling issue where promotional banner text is nearly unreadable due to insufficient color contrast.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely poor color contrast that makes the offer details and promo code hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background color (e.g., to a deep green matching the brand accent) or change the heading and subtitle text to a dark charcoal or dark green color to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
